boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Lafayette College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and snack stops with directly documented service at 11 p.m. or later, ranging from College Hill walks to Easton destinations that require a ride.

cards.title: Campus Corner Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: Pizza until 1 a.m. beside College Hill
cards.notes: Walk to Cattell Street, check the posted full-hours panel, and order before the listed 1 a.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A late-closing pizzeria immediately beside Lafayette's College Hill neighborhood.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant's ordering page identifies Campus Corner Pizzeria at 208 Cattell Street and lists service from 1 p.m. to 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The current page lists 1:00 p.m.–1:00 a.m.; consult its Full Hours panel before departing because daily schedules may vary.

cards.title: Wawa on Cattell Street
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour College Hill convenience stop
cards.notes: Use the Cattell Street entrance for an all-night snack run, and confirm prepared-food availability after midnight.
cards.short_summary: The closest documented round-the-clock convenience option to Lafayette's main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The map listing identifies Wawa at 225 Cattell Street in Easton and states that it is open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Listed open 24 hours every day. Individual prepared-food stations or services may follow narrower schedules.

cards.title: Wawa on South 25th Street
cards.subtitle: Round-the-clock snacks in Palmer Township
cards.notes: Plan a ride to South 25th Street, use the 24-hour store for supplies, and verify any made-to-order counter options.
cards.short_summary: A second all-night Wawa serving the eastern Easton and Palmer area.
cards.evidence_claim: The map listing identifies Wawa at 631 South 25th Street in Easton and states that it is open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Listed open 24 hours every day. This destination requires a ride from campus; food counters may have separate availability.

cards.title: Sunoco on South Wood Street
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour convenience-store fallback
cards.notes: Travel with a planned ride, stop inside for packaged snacks or essentials, and keep the official location page handy.
cards.short_summary: A documented 24-hour South Side Easton stop with a convenience store.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunoco's official page identifies the station at 201 South Wood Street, lists it as open 24 hours, and confirms an on-site convenience store with snacks.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed open 24 hours. The page confirms convenience-store snacks; individual services may be unavailable overnight.

cards.title: Sunoco on Freemansburg Avenue
cards.subtitle: Prepared food at a 24-hour station
cards.notes: Arrange transportation to Freemansburg Avenue and check the prepared-food selection before counting on a full meal.
cards.short_summary: An all-night Easton station whose official listing specifically includes prepared food.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunoco's official page identifies the station at 3337-41 Freemansburg Avenue, lists 24-hour operation, and names prepared food as an amenity.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed open 24 hours with prepared food. This is a ride from campus, and overnight food selection may be limited.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Northampton Street
cards.subtitle: Drive-through service into the early morning
cards.notes: Check the day-specific schedule and plan vehicle access, since the drive-through remains open later than the dining room.
cards.short_summary: A late drive-through whose closing time extends well past midnight on most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page lists drive-through hours as late as 2:30 a.m. on most nights and 3:30 a.m. Friday and Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Easton, PA - 2420 Northampton St
cards.access_notes: Drive-through: midnight Wednesday, 2:30 a.m. most other nights, and 3:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Dine-in is listed only until 1 a.m.

cards.title: Pizza Boli's of Easton
cards.subtitle: Pizza service until 12:30 a.m. nightly
cards.notes: Order ahead from Butler Street, choose pickup or delivery, and submit the order comfortably before the 12:30 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A nightly post-midnight pizza option with both pickup and delivery ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Boli's official Easton page gives the address as 1534 Butler Street and lists hours of 10 a.m. to 12:30 a.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Easton, PA | Pizza Delivery or Carry-Out | Pizza Boli's
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 10:00 a.m.–12:30 a.m. daily. Confirm whether the final ordering cutoff precedes closing.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Freemansburg Avenue
cards.subtitle: Delivery and carryout until midnight
cards.notes: Enter the campus delivery address before ordering, verify the service area, and allow time before the midnight close.
cards.short_summary: A midnight pizza option with official delivery and carryout service information.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut's official Easton page lists the restaurant at 2527 Freemansburg Avenue and currently labels it open until midnight.
cards.source_title: Pizza Delivery & Carryout in Easton, PA | Pizza Hut
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists closing at midnight. Delivery range and last-order cutoff should be checked when ordering.

cards.title: Papa Johns on South 25th Street
cards.subtitle: Carryout and delivery past midnight
cards.notes: Choose delivery or arrange a ride for carryout, then check the weekday schedule before placing a late order.
cards.short_summary: A post-midnight pizza counter with equally late listed delivery and carryout hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns' official location page lists delivery and carryout until 12:45 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 1:45 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Pizza in Easton, PA | Papa Johns South 25th Street
cards.access_notes: Delivery and carryout run until 12:45 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:45 a.m. Friday–Saturday, according to the official page.

cards.title: Applebee's on Easton-Nazareth Highway
cards.subtitle: A sit-down option serving until 11 p.m.
cards.notes: Arrange a ride to the Easton-Nazareth corridor and arrive early enough to order before the listed 11 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A late sit-down meal option for groups needing an all-ages dining room.
cards.evidence_claim: Applebee's official Easton page identifies the restaurant at 3702 Easton-Nazareth Highway and currently lists it as open until 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Applebee's Grill + Bar in Easton, PA
cards.access_notes: The official page lists service until 11 p.m. Check the live page before traveling because day-specific closing times can change.

warnings: Late hours can change during holidays, academic breaks, or staffing disruptions; recheck each linked page before departure.
Eight destinations require a ride or delivery from Lafayette's main campus; only the Cattell Street locations are immediately beside College Hill.
